title: International — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: WCBT encourages global perspectives through KU-aligned standards, digital learning, and future mobility pathways.

blocks.heading: What international perspective means at WCBT
paras: International does not only mean studying abroad. It means preparing students to understand global standards, digital work, cross-cultural communication, and the expectations of modern technology and education careers.

groups.title: Academic preparation
text: KU-aligned academic delivery gives students a structured foundation for graduate study, professional certifications, and future academic mobility. Students are encouraged to build strong portfolios, communication skills, and project experience.

groups.title: Career readiness
text: Technology and education careers increasingly require global awareness. WCBT supports students through digital learning exposure, English communication practice, presentation work, and practical skills that transfer across workplaces.

groups.title: Global Perspective
text: Programs connect students with technology trends and global practices.

groups.title: Academic Standards
text: KU-aligned delivery prepares students for higher study and careers.

groups.title: Future Study
text: Guidance supports students considering graduate study in Nepal or abroad.

groups.title: Mobility Pathways
text: The college continues building links that expand student opportunities.

blocks.heading: How students can prepare for global pathways
bullets: Build a strong academic record through consistent coursework and assessments.
Develop project portfolios that show practical technical and problem-solving ability.
Improve communication, presentation, teamwork, and documentation skills.
Participate in workshops, seminars, research activities, and industry exposure.
Discuss graduate study plans early with faculty, advisors, and administration.
Stay informed about documentation, deadlines, scholarships, and program requirements.

blocks.heading: Explore future pathways
paras: Talk with WCBT about programs, preparation, and international study goals.
